name: pyupcheck
description: See the lines of your Python code that a dependency upgrade breaks, and fix them with pyupcheck migrate.

pyupcheck.path.description: The pyupcheck executable (pip install pyupcheck). Set a full path if it isn't on PATH, e.g. a virtual environment's.

pyupcheck.deep.description: Diff the real API of each version (slower, more accurate).

enumDescriptions: Re-check when a requirements file, pyproject.toml or lockfile is saved
Also re-check when a Python file or notebook is saved
Only check on startup and with the command

pyupcheck.minSeverity.description: The least severe finding to show.

pyupcheck.showWarnings.description: Also show low-confidence mentions (code that touches an API the changelog mentions).
